## What is wrong?

- [ ] **Incorrect** — the documentation contradicts actual behaviour
- [ ] **Unclear** — it is accurate but hard to follow
- [ ] **Missing** — a topic is not covered at all
- [ ] **Outdated** — it was accurate but no longer is
- [ ] **Broken link or example**
